title: Plains of Nineveh, Nimrud & Erbil
full_text:
Early morning head to the Plains of Nineveh. Have breakfast with a local Christian family in Bahzani and learn their stories and history.
Visit some of the Yazidi temples in the town.
Then head to the archaeological site of Nimrud (Kalhu) — one of the Assyrian capitals.
Head to Erbil and, depending on time, check into the hotel and visit the citadel and the surrounding bustling markets.
